The '''Thirty-eighth Fleet''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Thirty-eighth Fleet was first mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|Onslaught]]'' expansion of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. In the Imperial storyline, [[Darth Malgus]] thanks the [[Alliance Commander]] for the assistance with the fleet's operations before recalling it for another assignment.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref>
